title: Swap tokens
lead: Trade a user token for PPL, or PPL for a token, using a shared liquidity pool. Amounts are whole units. A 0.30% fee stays in the pool for liquidity providers. The usual network fee in PPL is paid separately.
walletHint: Unlock your wallet to sign. The network must be reachable.
poolsEmpty: No token/PPL pools yet. Create one below if you hold both sides.
success: The network accepted the signed transaction.
needWallet: Create or unlock a wallet first.
helpK: The pool keeps x × y = k with exact integer math. Output is rounded down, in the pool's favour.
helpLock: A small minimum of LP shares stays locked so the pool cannot be emptied. Liquidity that arrived from a bonding-curve migration stays locked too.
tokensEmpty: No tokens on this network yet. Launch one in Token Factory — swap pools appear after liquidity is added.
gasFeeNote: Paid as gas in PPL when you sign
approveReverted: Token approval failed, nothing was swapped. Try again.
approveTimeout: Token approval is still pending. Check your wallet, then try again.
allowanceLow: The approval did not go through (allowance is too low). Try again.
